info.title: Reva Guardrail APIs
info.description: Public APIs for guardrail templates, rules, rule drafts, rule testing, guardrail stores, and policy-store guardrail resolution.

tags.name: Guardrail Rules
tags.description: Manage guardrail rules, drafts, tests, and violations.

tags.name: Guardrail Stores
tags.description: Manage guardrail stores and store-level guardrail configurations.

tags.name: Policy Store Guardrail Resolution
tags.description: Resolve guardrails linked to policy stores and drafts.

get.description: Returns guardrail templates. Optional filters include type, category, and AI lifecycle stage.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter by template type: DESIGN_TIME or RUN_TIME

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Filter by template category: AI or STANDARD

parameters.name: aiStage
parameters.description: Filter by AI lifecycle stage: ENTRY, EXIT or BOTH. When ENTRY/EXIT is supplied, BOTH-tagged templates are also returned.
